# Pull Request Template

## Description
<!-- Describe what this PR does and why -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] CI/CD improvement

## Testing
<!-- How did you test this? -->
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compiles (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] Manual testing performed:
  - [ ] CLI
  - [ ] Browser client
  - [ ] macOS app

## Privacy & Security
<!-- Does this change affect the privacy model or security? -->
- [ ] No privacy/security impact
- [ ] Privacy model change (explain in Security Impact)
- [ ] New external integration (explain in Security Impact)
- [ ] Encryption/storage changes (explain in Security Impact)
